title: SessionSetMode
description: Change the permission mode, model and/or effort of a session. Claude applies them at once; Codex and Antigravity from the next turn. Daemons with the session_controls feature answer with session.mode_set.

permission_mode.description: Claude: the SDK permission mode. Codex: auto = workspace-write + on-request with approvals reviewed by Codex's auto_review, default = workspace-write + untrusted, bypassPermissions = danger-full-access + never. Antigravity: default = ask, bypassPermissions = auto.

effort.description: Thinking effort (Claude effortLevel, Codex reasoning effort); null leaves it. Antigravity has none (the effort is part of the model id).
